scan.label: Scan a work order or a bundle ticket

camera.error: The camera does not open: use the scanner or type the code.

hint.pick: Scan the work order's traveller, a bundle ticket to fix it, or pick a work order below.
hint.proposal: Scan another work order, or a bundle ticket to fix it.
hint.card: Scan another ticket, or a work order to bundle it.

noPermission.title: Bundles are not for your role
noPermission.body: Making bundles and printing tickets needs the bundles permission at this station. Ask your team leader.

empty.title: Nothing cut is waiting for bundles
empty.body: When pieces are cut, their work order comes here. Scan a traveller to open one anyway.

proposal.title: Proposed bundles
proposal.closed: This work order is not open (on hold, done or cancelled): no bundle can be made for it. Ask your team leader.
proposal.singlePiece: Made to measure: one garment per bundle, each with its own ticket.
proposal.singlePieceHeld: Made to measure: always one garment per bundle

size.label: Bundle size
size.min: One garment is the smallest bundle

cell.pending_one: {count} on its way from this tablet
cell.pending_other: {count} on their way from this tablet

held.printer: Pick the printer for the tickets first
held.closed: The work order is not open
held.nothing: Nothing cut waits for a bundle
held.tooMany: At most {count} bundles at once: make bigger bundles
held.making: Saving the bundles on this tablet…

printer.station: Tickets print on {name}, this station's printer.
printer.none: No label printer at this site: the tickets are not printed here. Ask the office to print them.
printer.noView: Your role does not see the print queue.

tickets.offline: No network: the bundles are saved on this tablet; their tickets print on the station's printer when the office records them.
tickets.codePending: Numbered by the office when it arrives
tickets.numbersLow_one: Only {count} ticket number left on this tablet: it gets more with the next send.
tickets.numbersLow_other: Only {count} ticket numbers left on this tablet: it gets more with the next send.

print.waiting: Prints when the office records it.
print.none: Not printed here: there is no label printer.
print.hidden: Printed by the office's queue (your role does not see it).

card.replaced: Ticket {scanned} was replaced by {code}: use the new ticket, throw the old one away.
card.voided: This bundle was voided: no scan takes it, and its ticket is not printed again.

held.network: Reprint and void need the network: they wait until it is back.

reprint.title: Why a new ticket?
reprint.body: The new ticket gets a new code; a scan of the old one says it was replaced.
reprint.done: New ticket {code}. Ticket {old} is replaced: throw it away.

void.title: Void this bundle?
void.body: No scan takes {code} any more. Its pieces go back to cut, not in bundles.

done.title: Bundle {code} is voided
done.body_one: Its {count} garment is back in cut, not in bundles.
done.body_other: Its {count} garments are back in cut, not in bundles.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: Bundles wait at this site until its floor is ready.
FLOOR_NOT_READY.fix: Ask your team leader: the office finishes setting up the floor rules.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: The work order is not open (on hold, done or cancelled).

NOT_CUT_FROM_HIDES.message: This size has no part cut from hides: it is not bundled here.

NOTHING_TO_BUNDLE.message: Nothing cut waits for a bundle in this size any more.
NOTHING_TO_BUNDLE.fix: Another tablet may have bundled it: read the work order again.

MORE_THAN_CUT.message: This is more than what was cut and is not in bundles.
MORE_THAN_CUT.fix: Make the bundle smaller, or cut the rest first.

NOT_A_PART.message: This part is not one of the size's parts.

SINGLE_PIECE.message: A made-to-measure garment goes in a bundle of its own.

TOO_MANY_BUNDLES.fix: Make bigger bundles, or make them in two goes.

SCANNED.message: This bundle was scanned already: a bundle is voided only before any scan.
SCANNED.fix: Ask your team leader to undo or correct its scans.

REPLACED.message: This ticket was replaced by a new one.
